decision_summary.text: The team will conduct a two-week, time-boxed discovery process with Northline to document their workflow and evaluate the feasibility of a reusable reporting layer, while explicitly avoiding production code or delivery commitments. Simultaneously, the team will define the scope of pending reliability work and core-workflow improvements to enable a final, informed prioritization decision.

source_evidence.speaker: assistant
source_evidence.quote: A short technical and workflow discovery could separate the reusable layer from Northline-specific behavior.

source_evidence.speaker: assistant
source_evidence.quote: I would frame that as learning, not as a quiet commitment to build the whole workspace.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: My provisional plan is to offer Northline three focused sessions over the next two weeks, document the workflow, and explicitly make no build commitment.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: Lina can lead the sessions but not start production code.

positions.text: Manage communication with Northline through human-centric, transparent language that sets boundaries without formal bureaucracy.

contributions.speaker: assistant
contributions.quote: You could tell Northline that the team is evaluating whether a reusable reporting foundation fits the product, not scheduling their requested workspace.

contributions.speaker: assistant
contributions.quote: That may disappoint them, but it is clearer than relying on different interpretations of “summer path.”

contributions.speaker: assistant
contributions.quote: You do not need to present a governance ceremony.

contributions.speaker: assistant
contributions.quote: The boundary can live in your internal plan and in a plain sentence to them.

contributions.speaker: assistant
contributions.quote: The substance can be human: acknowledge what they have contributed, explain that you are genuinely interested, and be honest that the team has other promises and reliability debt.

contributions.speaker: assistant
contributions.quote: Something like, “We want to understand this properly, but I do not want our curiosity to sound like a delivery promise.”

positions.text: Balance individual engineering motivation with team-wide reliability and capacity constraints.

contributions.speaker: user
contributions.quote: Forcing Lina onto reliability because it is responsible might burn her out; letting her chase the new layer might leave everyone else holding the risk.

contributions.speaker: assistant
contributions.quote: One possible design is to time-box her investigation while another owner defines the minimum reliability work that cannot slip, then reconvene with actual effort and ownership.

contributions.speaker: assistant
contributions.quote: But if the team cannot staff both without wishful allocation, the experiment will not solve the conflict; it will merely postpone naming it.
